name: Claude Developer Platform (Claude API)
description: Gives developers API access to Claude models through the Messages API, with streaming, tool use, batch processing, file uploads, and beta Managed Agents sessions.

skills.name: Messages API
skills.description: Sends single or multi-turn conversations to Claude models and returns their replies via POST /v1/messages.

skills.name: Tool Use
skills.description: Lets Claude call developer-defined and Anthropic-provided tools and return structured tool calls.

skills.name: Message Batches
skills.description: Processes large volumes of Messages requests asynchronously at 50% lower cost.

skills.name: Files API
skills.description: Uploads and manages files once for reuse across multiple API calls.

skills.name: Claude Managed Agents
skills.description: Runs versioned agent configurations as stateful sessions in Anthropic-managed or self-hosted sandboxes (beta).
